pages.text: Grapevines made a roof over the yard—a grape arbor. Plump grapes hung everywhere.
The plumpest bunch hung at the very top. Lulu reached. "I will pick that one."
Uncle Nino loosened his legs. "Nobody jumps like me! In my day, I jumped over roofs!"
He jumped. His toes were nowhere near high enough.
He jumped hard and grabbed an arbor post. The arbor wobbled.
He dangled from the post. "I-I am coming down..." The grapes swayed high above.
He landed with a thump and panted. The bunch still hung there.
Lulu rolled over an empty wooden tub, turned it upside down on the ground, and stood on it.
Up on tiptoe, Lulu could reach. Snip! The plump bunch landed in Lulu's arms.
Everyone shared Lulu's grapes. The loudest crunches came from Uncle Nino.
